questions.question: Which of the following is considered as pacemaker of human heart ?
Which of these has a double closed type of circulatory system ?
Role of pacemaker is :-
options: To initiate and maintain the minimum rhythmic contractile activity of the heart
To initiate and maintain the arhythmic contractile activity of the heart
To initiate and maintain the rhythmic contractile activity of blood vessels
To generate maximum action potentials for initiating and maintaining the rhythmic contractile activity of the heart
questions.explanation:
Question Explanation : The question asks about the main function or role of the pacemaker in the heart.

Concept : Function of SA node (natural pacemaker of heart)

Solution :
The SA node acts as the natural pacemaker. It generates   maximum action potentials automatically to initiate and maintain the rhythmic and coordinated contraction of the heart muscles, ensuring the heartbeat continues regularly.

Final Answer : Option (4)
